rows.title: Other Restructuring
rows.summary: This is to inform that REC US Holdings, Inc., a step-down wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, had voluntarily filed a certificate of dissolution with the Secretary of State of Delaware on July 6, 2026 and has been dissolved effective the said date. Accordingly, REC US Holdings, Inc. has ceased to be a subsidiary of the Company with effect from the aforesaid date.REC US Holdings, Inc. was a non-operating company and had Nil turnover in the calendar year 2025. Net worth of REC US Holdings, Inc. as on December 31, 2025 was Rs. 0.0009 crore, contributing 0.0000001% to the consolidated net worth of the Company for the financial year 2025-26.
